summary.intent: Wire CTR encryption mode into the SDK's uploadFile() function so that large media files use AES-CTR streaming instead of always defaulting to AES-GCM, enabling the streaming playback pipeline for newly uploaded files.
summary.outcome: CTR encryption is now correctly selected for large media files (>256KB) via a centralized selectEncryptionMode() utility in sdk-core, shared across the SDK client and web app. PR #399 was created, E2E tests confirmed the feature works end-to-end, and all automated review comments were resolved.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed in apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts but was only used for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path, never for new SDK uploads — a latent feature gap.
sdk-core must be rebuilt before typechecking sdk, since sdk imports compiled types from sdk-core's build output rather than source.
STREAMING_MIME_TYPES was duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — this caused the FLAC omission to exist in both places.
The web app's streaming-crypto.service.ts selectEncryptionMode takes a File object, while the centralized version takes (mimeType, size) — the web app uses a thin wrapper.
Integration tests in packages/sdk hit live API endpoints and are expected to fail in local/CI environments — pre-existing issue unrelated to changes.
SDK test files that mock @cipherbox/sdk-core with a bare factory (not importActual/importOriginal) silently drop all real exports, causing failures when new exports are added.

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm and 'GCM' mode — added optional encryptionMode param to branch between CTR and GCM paths
New centralized module: STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB), selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), normalizeEncryptionMode() with coercion of invalid values to GCM
uploadFile() now calls selectEncryptionMode() before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile(), importing the function from sdk-core
CTR encrypted badge test was skipped with test.skip — removed skip after implementing the feature
vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core') bare factory broke when selectEncryptionMode was added — fixed with importOriginal spread pattern
PublishIpnsResponseDto no longer has 'cid' field; ResolveIpnsResponseDto no longer has 'source' field — mocks were stale
addToIpfs mock was returning {cid} but IpfsAddResult requires {cid, size, recorded}

workflow: Vite dev server picks up rebuilt workspace packages via HMR — rebuilding sdk-core/sdk before running E2E tests against local dev is sufficient.
Using importOriginal + spread in vi.mock() factories is more resilient than bare factories — bare factories silently drop all real exports on new additions.
GraphQL API for GitHub review threads can time out; falling back to REST PR comments API is a reliable alternative for fetching unresolved threads.
When centralizing a utility that takes different argument shapes in different consumers (File object vs mimeType+size), the shared function should take primitives and callers wrap.

friction: GraphQL reviewThreads query timed out, requiring a fallback to REST PR comments API to fetch unresolved threads.
sdk typecheck fails with stale build artifacts until sdk-core is explicitly rebuilt — not obvious why types were wrong initially.
Five SDK test files needed the same mock fix (importOriginal pattern) — discovered incrementally via CI failure rather than upfront.
Git push conflicted with remote changes after the centralization commit, requiring stash/rebase/pop dance.
FLAC omission from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES was not caught during initial implementation — only noticed post-PR by the user.
